info.title: Hengshuo JXC controlled contract baseline
info.description: Generated registration catalogue plus reviewed M1 foundation and M2/M3/M4 main-flow contracts. Controller-only registration remains distinct from tested business behavior. Unknown evidence remains unknown; blocked/deferred operations are not real backend functionality.

200.description: Existing camelCase response in {code,message,data,traceId}.

x-contract-evidence.scope: Current authenticated identity; /login is anonymous, /me lists only authorized countries; /logout revokes the current token hash under the global authorization gate.
x-contract-evidence.field: No password/hash returned. /me returns only safe identity, authorized countries, permissions and current fieldGroups.

idem.strategy: No public Idempotency-Key binding on this operation. Read/state/version rules apply; clients must not globally retry writes.

x-contract-evidence.facts: Login inserts hashed session and last-login metadata. Logout revokes current session and increments global authorization epoch. No business facts.

permissions.interpretation: Observed guard calls only; conditions and referenced helpers require review.

200.description: Authorized bounded response envelope.

x-contract-evidence.scope: Current country; exact native book/entity/store/warehouse scope. Disabled countries retain authorized historical reads.
x-contract-evidence.field: Native current field policy remains authoritative; files, recipients and delegates cannot grant authority.

Failed DB commit may leave a private orphan; no automatic destructive cleanup.
